findings.reason: A sparsity-envelope sequence materially clarifies the two simultaneous invariant clauses: the cleared column advances while the permitted exceptional row bound advances. The original screenshot and identical frozen/current source contain no illustration. This is an explanatory addition, not a gap in the rigorous proof.
findings.action: Added two indexed 7-by-7 sparsity envelopes in final Remarks for n=7,r=2,j=2, plus explicit one-step, truncated terminal and initial-direction explanations.

correction: Appended a final Remarks section with a native TikZ sparsity-envelope illustration. Original source is preserved byte-for-byte as the prefix of the corrected source; no original mathematical or metadata text changed.

diagram_math_checks.data: Two 7-by-7 matrices H_2 and H_3=P_2^*H_2P_2; n=7,r=2,j=2; P_2 acts on I_2={3,4,5}.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Statement and step 1.2: supported unitary reflector is a map F^7 to F^7; both left and right products have the same matrix dimensions. The arrow denotes conjugation, not an entrywise operation.

diagram_math_checks.data: Each panel has 49 locations: 34 white dots at i<=k+1, three cyan dots below that band, and 12 zero labels. Left cyan positions are (4,2),(5,2),(5,3); right cyan positions are (5,3),(6,3),(6,4).
diagram_math_checks.justification: P(2) from step 1.1 forces columns k<2 to be Hessenberg and all exceptional entries to i<=5. P(3) from steps 1.2 and 2.1 forces k<3 Hessenberg and exceptions to i<=6. These sets give exactly the drawn positions. Dots mean permitted, not required nonzero, so no claim of generic fill is asserted.

diagram_math_checks.data: Orange outline encloses rows 3,4,5 of column 2 in both panels; after conjugation its last two entries are zero. Column 1 remains unchanged, and the possible exceptional row boundary moves from 5 to 6.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Step 1.2 aligns (H_2)_{I_2,2}; right multiplication acts only on columns 3,4,5. Earlier column 1 has zero entries on rows I_2 so its left update also leaves it unchanged. Step 2.1 provides the row bound. Dashed lines lie immediately below rows 5 and 6.

diagram_math_checks.data: For r=1 support length <=2 and row bound j+2 advances to j+3; for r=2 length <=3 and bound j+3 advances to j+4, truncated at n. At j=n-2 both supports are {n-1,n}.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Substitution in I_j and P(j), then step 3.1. Last two columns cannot have i>k+1; n<=2 has J=0. These terminal cases are stated in prose rather than falsely implied by the interior n=7 frames.

diagram_math_checks.data: P_j e_1=e_1 for j>=1, and Qe_1=P_0e_1=x/alpha under the additional hypothesis.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Every I_j starts at j+1>=2; the definition of supported reflector and proof step 3.1 establish this relation. It is explained in Remarks; the unchanged rigorous proof establishes the conclusion independently of the picture.
